evidence.art: Painted stills 005-018 and the title (000_title) are coherent night/amber-teal AAA illustration. The 3D walk set (020_walk, 040_walk_cut5) matches the palette, but the characters are visibly lower-fidelity than the painting.
evidence.continuity: Anpu is painted in his full jackal-head and bronze regalia in 016_film and 017_film. In the walk (024_walk_cut2, 019_walk) he is a flat black silhouette: his ankh is unreadable, his sceptre is a thin dark pole, and his proportions differ. In 021_walk_cut1 and 023_walk the attendants look different from the painted ones. Ankhu's sandals are present throughout (023_walk, 040_walk_cut5). The tint on Ankhu changes to pink in 037_walk_cut4 and 038_walk. The ankh and was-sceptre are not legible against canon (ankh about 0.32 m, Set head at ear height).
evidence.cinematography_cuts: The film frames compose well: 013_film and 014_film frame Anpu low and heroic, and 018_film shows the group walking toward the causeway. Cut 021_walk_cut1 to 024_walk_cut2 is clear. Cut 037_walk_cut4 is a steep high angle that loses the characters and the destination. The end card 047_walk to 049_walk is well composed.
evidence.motion_fx: Poses in 026_walk to 036_walk change only slightly from frame to frame. Legs are stiff, with a slide-and-march gait. Arms hang with no swing, and there is no visible dust. Anpu's sceptre barely moves with his steps.
evidence.character_grounding: Shadows are present and mostly plausible (028_walk, 039_walk). In 039_walk the attendant at the left edge looks like it is floating. In 025_walk the figures are tiny against the statue. In 044_walk the group sits in the gate shadow but reads as pasted on, because the lighting on the figures does not match the warm set lighting. Anpu's black legs lose all form against the dark ground.
evidence.game_feel: The cameras are fixed and the dialogue is paced, but the group is very small in the frame for long stretches (030_walk_cut3 to 036_walk). It is not obvious where to go next, since 037_walk_cut4 shows no destination. The pace is slow, and the player's agency is unclear.
evidence.ui_title: The title (001_title) has strong hierarchy: gold serif logo, a clear selected state on BEGIN JOURNEY, and legible menu type. The subtitles are legible with a drop shadow (024_walk_cut2). The end card (047_walk) is tidy. 050_title_return fades the logo in smoothly. The menu type is a little small and low-contrast over the dark column (000_title).
evidence.audio_dialogue: Judged from the subtitle script and timing visible in the frames, not from audio. The lines are well written and paced: 'I served your house for forty years', 'I know. I was there each time you lifted the mask', and 'Walk with me, Ankhu'. Timing between subtitle changes looks sensible, and the fixed-camera cuts land on line changes.

defects.what: Anpu in the 3D walk is a black silhouette with no readable ankh, a thin pole for a sceptre, and none of the painted bronze and gold regalia. He does not match the painted character.
The walk animation shows little pose variety. Gaits are stiff, arms do not swing, and there is no foot dust or contact FX.

Characters are tiny and lit unlike the set, and Ankhu goes pink in 037_walk_cut4 and 038_walk. Silhouettes against the painted background read as pasted on. The attendant at the left edge of 039_walk appears to float.
